title: Life Experience / Product Quality Hardening

baseline.environment: postgres 18.4 @ 127.0.0.1:5434 (persisted /tmp/realpg cluster, PID 1619 alive after env reset)

defects.title: Difficulty escalated for inactive users on a stale completion rate
defects.reproduce: C-comeback day 15: inactiveDays=6, momentum falling, recovery active, yet difficulty=MEDIUM(increase) reason='High completion rate (100%) — ready for a harder challenge.' (30-day completion rate stayed high while the user was away)
defects.root_cause: recommendDifficulty increased difficulty whenever 30-day completion rate >= 0.7, ignoring that the user was not active today — the rate was stale relative to the current activity gap
defects.fix: gate the 'increase' branch on state.inactiveDays < 1; add a stale-rate branch that reports 'High completion rate but not active today — maintaining difficulty.'
defects.regression_test: life-engine-engines.test.ts: 'does not escalate a user who is not active today (stale completion rate)'; product-intelligence.test.ts C2 classifier (D only when inactiveDays>=1)

contradiction_matrix.remaining_B_breakdown: 532 weakness_vs_reason (recommendation targets a weak area without a WEAK_AREA reason code — presentation-level, explainable) + 2 momentum_vs_difficulty (active-today but momentum still lagging after a return — soft time-window difference)

feedback_loops.note: H-oscillating stays in recovery because it abandons a quest every other day (>=2 in 30d) — a documented policy behavior, not a latch from a single event; momentum bounded <= 100 and recovery reason always present.

longitudinal_365_day_sim.result: PASS — all 5 personas remain sane at day 365

findings_yellow.finding: No per-day XP cap and no quest repeatability/frequency field on quest templates — a user can assign→complete the same ACTIVE template repeatedly for unbounded total-XP and attribute-XP
findings_yellow.evidence: quests.ts assign guard only blocks the same template while ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS; completion awards XP idempotently per instance (new questId each time); schema has no cooldown/frequency/repeatable column
findings_yellow.mitigation: sqrt level curve bounds LEVEL inflation (not total XP or attribute XP); self-tracking product with no competitive stakes shipped yet
findings_yellow.recommendation: introduce a per-day XP budget and/or template repeatability policy before shipping leaderboard/social stakes

findings_yellow.finding: Rate limiting is applied only to auth endpoints; quest/task completion endpoints are unthrottled
findings_yellow.recommendation: add a completion rate limiter if abuse is observed

ai_boundary.offline_behavior: deterministic surfaces work with GROQ_API_KEY absent; open-ended chat returns 503 'AI coach is not configured'

data_consistency.duplicate_level_calculation: none found — users/me/level and social leaderboard both read raw current_level from user_levels

performance.note: per-user cost does not degrade as batch grows; 100k events/user is ~274 years of daily tasks (extreme) and still completes in ~24ms

ui_product_journeys: UNVERIFIED — no browser available in this environment; frontend consumers (dashboard, use-ai, leaderboard) reviewed statically and are contract-compatible with the reviewed endpoints

fix_policy.policy: REPRODUCE → CLASSIFY → ROOT CAUSE → MINIMAL FIX → REGRESSION TEST → FULL REGRESSION
fix_policy.reproduced_via_probe: C-comeback days 10-29 probe confirmed stale-rate escalation before fix

quality_score.anti_gaming: PASS with 2 documented YELLOW risks (AG-1 class C, AG-2 class B)
quality_score.goal_lifecycle: PASS (decomposition + I-goal-changer mid-sim goal switch propagates)
quality_score.failure_recovery: PASS (AI timeout wrapper + graceful 503 + deterministic fallback)

final_report.DEFECT_CLASSES: D x1 (correctness); no A/B/C/E defects remaining
final_report.DOCUMENTED_RISKS: AG-1 (class C, unbounded XP farming via repeatable quests), AG-2 (class B, no completion rate limiting)
final_report.RECOMMENDED_NEXT_STEP: Ship; address AG-1 (per-day XP budget / template repeatability) before enabling leaderboard/social competitive stakes
